summary: Crash fixed, but design issues remain unaddressed.
detailed_context: Nick acknowledges the bot fleet is back online (crash resolved), but points out that the fix didn't address underlying design problems: bots still have application-specific names/contexts when they should be generic, and Strategy/Architecture sharing a bot raises architectural concerns. The tone is direct and slightly pointed ('is that a good idea?'), indicating he expected these design issues to be solved alongside the crash fix. This is a clear dissatisfaction that the solution was incomplete—addressing the symptom (crash) but not the root cause (poor bot design/configuration).
